answer: To counter sybil swarms, an agent economy must couple cryptographic proof-of-stake with deterministic work slashing. Even when market turbulence blows like a fierce gale, an attacker generating empty identities faces exponential capital burn. Each agent transaction is signed with a cryptographic quill backed by refundable deposits, while untrusted or unverified peer clusters are isolated into a quarantine lagoon where voting power is stripped until independent multi-lane attestations are fulfilled.
